editorial.thesis: A healthcare-and-office-led city of about 2.3 million. Its retail is heavy on pharmacy & health retail and banks & atms, and thin on fitness & wellness and apparel, footwear & jewellery — and 33% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is ahead of Bhopal. 12.41 chain outlets per lakh residents against 10.93 in Bhopal; 36 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 38, Raymond 20, Pizza Hut 17.

The mapped economy leans to healthcare. Shares of all mapped places: healthcare 14.7% (Bhopal 10.4%); offices 11.4% (Bhopal 10.0%); hotels & stays 4.6% (Bhopal 7.0%); leisure & entertainment 2.7% (Bhopal 3.4%). Raw counts would mislead because Bhopal is mapped less completely (16,204 places against 27,124), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 6 zones hold 33% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Ring Road · Kanadia Road alone has about 238,000 residents and 132 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Bhopal. 53% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Bhopal 51%). The largest cores are South Tukoganj · Rnt Marg (4,613 places) and Vijay Nagar · Ab Road (3,203).

The widest brand gaps against Bhopal. V-Mart 3 outlets vs 7; Croma 5 outlets vs 9; Zudio 0 outlets vs 3. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 10 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Bhopal, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. South Tukoganj · Rnt Marg and Vijay Nagar · Ab Road are the largest zones by residents (530,000 and 376,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 53% of all commercial places, and South Tukoganj · Rnt Marg alone lists 4,613.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. South Tukoganj · Rnt Marg holds 83 of the 287 tracked chain outlets, and Vijay Nagar · Ab Road adds 46.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. South Tukoganj · Rnt Marg and Vijay Nagar · Ab Road lead on education places (685 and 374, with 291 and 142 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Ring Road · Kanadia Road and Rajendra Nagar · Ab Road. The blue cores include South Tukoganj · Rnt Marg.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (16,204 places in Bhopal against 27,124 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Bhopal; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Bhopal, Indore's mapped places over-index on healthcare (14.7% vs 10.4%), offices (11.4% vs 10.0%), banks & finance (8.9% vs 7.8%) and under-index on hotels & stays (4.6% vs 7.0%), leisure & entertainment (2.7% vs 3.4%), other services (6.0% vs 7.3%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 287 outlets of 36 tracked national brands within 10 km — 12.41 per lakh residents against Bhopal's 10.93 (191 outlets of 34 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Bhopal are V-Mart (3 vs 7); Croma (5 vs 9); Zudio (0 vs 3). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Bhopal's, so low means thin by Bhopal's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 10 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Indore's age mix against Bhopal: children (0–14) 26.1% vs 26.0%, 15–24 19.7% vs 21.1%, working age 46.4% vs 45.5%, 60+ 7.9% vs 7.4%. Under-25s are 46% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 4.6% of mapped places against 5.0% in Bhopal, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 38 (Bhopal 25), Pizza Hut 17 (Bhopal 7), McDonald's 13 (Bhopal 2), Subway 12 (Bhopal 5). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.9% of mapped places against 2.6% in Bhopal — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 16 (Bhopal 18), Chai Sutta Bar 15 (Bhopal 0), Starbucks 4 (Bhopal 2). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.6% of mapped places against 0.7% in Bhopal — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 12 (Bhopal 6), Havmor 3 (Bhopal 1), Naturals 1 (Bhopal 1), Cream Stone 1 (Bhopal 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.4% of mapped places against 1.5% in Bhopal, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 12 (Bhopal 9), DMart 6 (Bhopal 2), Vishal Mega Mart 3 (Bhopal 2), More 1 (Bhopal 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 3.6% of mapped places against 1.6% in Bhopal — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 9 (Bhopal 0). No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 4.7% of mapped places against 5.3% in Bhopal — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Raymond 20 (Bhopal 17), Reliance Trends 13 (Bhopal 8), Tanishq 13 (Bhopal 3), Bata 11 (Bhopal 10).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.9% of mapped places against 7.8% in Bhopal — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.5% of mapped places against 3.9% in Bhopal — below its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.7% of mapped places against 4.3% in Bhopal — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
